description: This file is a script for scanning source files in a repository to identify potential security or boundary violations related to 'firecrawl' fetch logic. It performs directory traversal, pattern matching, and outputs violations related to specific 'firecrawl' usage patterns in the source code.

methods.name: collectWebFetchProviderBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Traverses source files in the repository to detect lines containing 'firecrawl' with suspicious patterns indicating boundary violations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that runs the violation collection and outputs results in JSON or plain text.
